name: Catholicism
overview: Scripture emphasizes the purity and authority of God's word as the foundation for faith, warning against idolatry and the making of graven images, as seen in Exodus 20:4. True obedience to God's will, rather than mere verbal profession, is essential for entering His kingdom (Matthew 7:21). While Christ affirms building His church on the rock of Peter (Matthew 16:18), He also cautions against elevating human authority above God, instructing believers not to call any man 'father' on earth since God alone is the Father (Matthew 23:9). Jeremiah 23:11 highlights the danger of corrupt leaders, underscoring the need for faithfulness to God's pure word (Proverbs 30:5) rather than reliance on human traditions or profane practices.
